mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate at or below 0.1% signals aggressive monetary easing that compresses discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in FEDFUNDS <= 0.1% periods are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A monthly CPIAUCSL increase exceeding 0.5% signals accelerating inflation, prompting central bank tightening that reduces equity risk appetite and produces negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances (CPIAUCSL rise > 0.5% in 1 month), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: When unemployment rate (UNRATE) is below 5.0% and real sales (RSAFS) exceeds its 12-month average, it indicates labor market tightness supporting consumer spending, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: The joint condition (UNRATE < 5.0% and RSAFS > 12-month avg) fails to produce positive returns in > 40% of instances, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: In high inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL > 3% annualized), a decline in industrial production (INDPRO) signals economic slowdown, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: In high inflation regimes, INDPRO declines do not lead to negative returns in > 60% of cases, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production (INDPRO) above its 6-month average signals robust manufacturing output, supporting corporate earnings growth and positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: INDPRO increases fail to produce positive returns in > 40% of instances, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts (HOUST) falling below 1600 thousand units signals residential construction contraction, reducing consumer confidence and leading to negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: HOUST < 1600.0 fails to predict negative returns in > 40% of cases, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: When real sales (RSAFS) rises above its 12-month average and housing starts (HOUST) falls below 1600 thousand units, it indicates sectoral consumption shift reducing equity volatility and producing negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: The joint condition (RSAFS > 12-month avg and HOUST < 1600) fails to produce negative returns in > 40% of instances, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in unemployment rate (UNRATE) over the past 6 months signals labor market tightening, increasing wage pressures and corporate profit margins, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: UNRATE declines over 6 months fail to produce positive returns in > 40% of instances, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year windows.
